title: AI Business Management System
description: A business management system built for a real company to centralize inventory, purchases, sales, customers, suppliers, and accounts receivable using PostgreSQL. The platform provides operational workflows and business summaries, with an AI layer in development for natural-language queries and operations.

title: IFARMA LABS Corporate Website
description: A responsive corporate website developed for a medical and pharmaceutical distribution company. The site presents the company's services, product catalog, partner brands, corporate information, and contact channels through a clean and accessible interface.

title: Celestial Bodies Database
description: A relational database developed as a certification project, modeling galaxies, stars, planets, and moons using PostgreSQL. The project includes primary keys, foreign keys, table relationships, constraints, and multiple data types.

title: User Settings Manager
description: A Python project for managing user application settings through create, update, delete, and view operations. The project uses dictionaries, functions, input normalization, validation, and conditional logic to manage configuration data.
